primary_evidence_status: Theoretical derivation and exact rational interval certification
decisive_result: A source-fixed 35-column minor of the actual UB612 U4 35-by-55 second-osculating response has an exact rational Krawczyk/Beeck/Collatz upper bound of about 0.012750158721617564, strictly below one. The minor is therefore nonsingular throughout the entire saved independent coefficient interval box, so the actual response has row rank 35 without requiring a correlated backend replay.

counter_intuition_scan.strongest_counterpattern: The first poorly conditioned minor could not separate the thirty-fifth mode from zero.
counter_intuition_scan.resolution: A different source-fixed 35-column minor plus exact positive diagonal preconditioning passes on the larger independent interval box; the prior failure was conditioning, not a missing physical direction.
counter_intuition_scan.ordinary_explanation: A full-row-rank rectangular matrix can contain both nearly singular and well-certifiable square minors.
counter_intuition_scan.falsifier: An error in the fixed column map, exact residual arithmetic, interval-radius propagation, or source-generator typing.

claim_ceiling: BGCE449 certifies rank 35 across the full saved independent UB612 U4 coefficient interval box for the declared same-carrier second-osculating source response. It does not identify that response with the full metric Frechet Hessian, generate full sigma6 or the parallel operator, prove arbitrary nonpolynomial child-sampling convergence, establish empirical gravity, or complete physical UV quantum gravity.
